data.title: TARC Successfully Challenges HARERA's Forfeiture of Security Deposit
data.summary: TARC successfully appealed against a HARERA order to forfeit a Rs. 25 lakh security deposit for a minor two-day delay in submitting a fire safety approval. The appellate tribunal deemed the penalty disproportionate and ordered a refund.
data.insight: The Haryana Real Estate Appellate Tribunal set aside an order by the Haryana Real Estate Regulatory Authority (HARERA) that had directed the forfeiture of a Rs. 25 lakh security deposit from TARC Limited. The forfeiture was for a two-day delay in submitting a fire scheme approval. The tribunal found the penalty to be 'grossly disproportionate' and 'punitive for technicalities,' especially since the delay was minor, unintentional, and caused by factors beyond the promoter's control, with no prejudice to homebuyers. The tribunal directed HARERA to refund the security deposit.

data.title: Haryana Real Estate Tribunal Sets Aside Penalty on TARC, Orders Refund of Security Deposit
data.summary: TARC Ltd. won an appeal in the Haryana Real Estate Appellate Tribunal, which overturned a decision by the lower authority to forfeit a Rs. 25,00,000 security deposit. The tribunal deemed the penalty for a delayed fire scheme approval to be 'grossly disproportionate' and ordered the amount to be refunded.
data.insight: The Haryana Real Estate Appellate Tribunal set aside an order by the Real Estate Regulatory Authority which had forfeited a security deposit of Rs. 25,00,000 from TARC Ltd. The forfeiture was for a delay in submitting a fire scheme approval. The Tribunal found the penalty to be disproportionate for a minor infraction, especially since other compliances were met and no homebuyer was prejudiced.
